boundary: Review instance only (no production write; production was read anonymously for the placeholder check). The stock fixture flips the shared product through WP-CLI and restores it in a finally block, read back afterwards. add-to-draft and loading-error close as not-applicable-today on measurement: the archive ships no operable add control and no client-side request whose failure could strand it. The two tests pin that absence, so a future client-side listing or a revealed placeholder fails them and reopens the rows.

followups.i18n_query_param_mismatch: DE /de/produkte/ prints ?anwendung=home links and a rel=alternate pointing at /products/?anwendung=home, but only ?application= is honoured (anwendung yields applied 0 and the unfiltered list). EN and DE filters therefore work through the shared English key; the German alias is not a working parameter. Not fixed here (out of this ticket's scope: an i18n routing change with its own acceptance), recorded so the row is not read as proving the German query vocabulary.
